Name: Egypt Personal Data Protection Law No. 151 of 2020 (readiness mapping)
Description: Readiness mapping for Egypt's Personal Data Protection Law No. 151 of 2020 and its Executive Regulations, maintained by the PDPL-Ready project. Requirements are grouped into 11 assessment areas; only technical safeguards carry automated checks, organisational requirements are listed as Manual. This mapping is a readiness aid, not a legal determination, and the requirement text has not been verified against the official legal texts.

Requirements.Name: A01.01 Appoint a Data Protection Officer
Requirements.Description: The organization has appointed a Data Protection Officer (DPO) with enough authority, time and independence to oversee personal data protection.

Attributes.Comment: Plain-language drafting, not legal text; not yet verified against the Law or its Executive Regulations.

Requirements.Name: A01.02 Register the DPO with the regulator
Requirements.Description: The DPO's appointment has been registered with the data protection regulator, and the registration details are kept up to date.

Attributes.Comment: Plain-language drafting, not legal text; not yet verified against the Law or its Executive Regulations.

Requirements.Name: A01.03 Approved data protection policy
Requirements.Description: A written data protection policy, approved by management, sets out how the organization handles personal data.

Attributes.Comment: Plain-language drafting, not legal text; not yet verified against the Law or its Executive Regulations.

Requirements.Name: A01.04 Staff awareness and training
Requirements.Description: Staff who handle personal data receive data protection training when they join and at regular intervals.

Attributes.Comment: Plain-language drafting, not legal text; not yet verified against the Law or its Executive Regulations.

Requirements.Name: A01.05 Documented accountability
Requirements.Description: The organization keeps records that show how it meets its data protection obligations, such as policies, decisions, assessments and reviews.

Attributes.Comment: Plain-language drafting, not legal text; not yet verified against the Law or its Executive Regulations.

Requirements.Name: A02.01 A lawful basis for every purpose
Requirements.Description: Each purpose for which personal data is processed has an identified lawful basis, recorded in the processing register.

Attributes.Comment: Plain-language drafting, not legal text; not yet verified against the Law or its Executive Regulations.

Requirements.Name: A02.02 Valid, recorded consent
Requirements.Description: Where processing relies on consent, the consent is specific, informed and recorded, and people can withdraw it as easily as they gave it.

Attributes.Comment: Plain-language drafting, not legal text; not yet verified against the Law or its Executive Regulations.

Requirements.Name: A02.03 Purpose limitation
Requirements.Description: Personal data is used only for the purposes people were told about, and new purposes are assessed before data is reused.

Attributes.Comment: Plain-language drafting, not legal text; not yet verified against the Law or its Executive Regulations.

Requirements.Name: A02.04 Sensitive personal data
Requirements.Description: Sensitive personal data, such as health or biometric data, is identified and handled under stricter controls.

Attributes.Comment: Plain-language drafting, not legal text; not yet verified against the Law or its Executive Regulations.

Requirements.Name: A02.05 Children's data
Requirements.Description: Where the organization processes children's personal data, it obtains a parent's or guardian's consent when required and applies extra care.

Attributes.Comment: Plain-language drafting, not legal text; not yet verified against the Law or its Executive Regulations.

Requirements.Name: A03.01 Privacy notice at collection
Requirements.Description: People receive a clear privacy notice when their data is collected, explaining who collects it, why, for how long, who receives it and what rights they have.

Attributes.Section: A03 Transparency and data subject rights
Attributes.Comment: Plain-language drafting, not legal text; not yet verified against the Law or its Executive Regulations.

Requirements.Name: A03.02 Handling data subject requests
Requirements.Description: A documented process receives and answers requests from people to access, correct, delete or object to the processing of their data, within the time the law allows.

Attributes.Section: A03 Transparency and data subject rights
Attributes.Comment: Plain-language drafting, not legal text; not yet verified against the Law or its Executive Regulations.

Requirements.Name: A03.03 Identity verification
Requirements.Description: Before acting on a request, the organization verifies the requester's identity without collecting more data than needed.

Attributes.Section: A03 Transparency and data subject rights
Attributes.Comment: Plain-language drafting, not legal text; not yet verified against the Law or its Executive Regulations.

Requirements.Name: A03.04 Request log
Requirements.Description: All requests are logged with the date received, the response date and the outcome.

Attributes.Section: A03 Transparency and data subject rights
Attributes.Comment: Plain-language drafting, not legal text; not yet verified against the Law or its Executive Regulations.

Requirements.Name: A04.01 Controller processing register
Requirements.Description: The organization keeps a register of its processing activities listing purposes, data categories, data subjects, recipients, retention periods and safeguards.

Attributes.Comment: Plain-language drafting, not legal text; not yet verified against the Law or its Executive Regulations.

Requirements.Name: A04.02 Processor register
Requirements.Description: Where the organization processes data on behalf of others, it keeps a separate register of that processing for each client.

Attributes.Comment: Plain-language drafting, not legal text; not yet verified against the Law or its Executive Regulations.

Requirements.Name: A04.03 Register kept current
Requirements.Description: The register is reviewed at set intervals and updated whenever a new system, supplier or purpose is introduced.

Attributes.Comment: Plain-language drafting, not legal text; not yet verified against the Law or its Executive Regulations.

Requirements.Name: A04.04 Data inventory
Requirements.Description: The organization knows which systems, files and suppliers hold personal data, and where they are located.

Attributes.Comment: Plain-language drafting, not legal text; not yet verified against the Law or its Executive Regulations.

Requirements.Name: A05.01 Data minimisation
Requirements.Description: Forms and systems collect only the personal data needed for the stated purpose.

Attributes.Comment: Plain-language drafting, not legal text; not yet verified against the Law or its Executive Regulations.

Requirements.Name: A05.02 Accuracy
Requirements.Description: Personal data is kept accurate and up to date, and errors are corrected without delay.

Attributes.Comment: Plain-language drafting, not legal text; not yet verified against the Law or its Executive Regulations.

Requirements.Name: A05.03 Retention periods enforced
Requirements.Description: Each category of personal data has a defined retention period, and data is deleted or anonymised when that period ends.

Attributes.Comment: Plain-language drafting, not legal text; not yet verified against the Law or its Executive Regulations.

Requirements.Name: A05.04 Backups protected and tested
Requirements.Description: Personal data is backed up, backups are protected to the same standard as live data, and restores are tested.

Attributes.Comment: Plain-language drafting, not legal text; not yet verified against the Law or its Executive Regulations.

Requirements.Name: A06.01 Encryption at rest
Requirements.Description: Storage holding personal data, including databases, disks, object storage, snapshots and laptops, is encrypted.

Attributes.Section: A06 Security of processing: access and encryption
Attributes.Comment: Plain-language drafting, not legal text; not yet verified against the Law or its Executive Regulations.

Requirements.Name: A06.02 Encryption in transit
Requirements.Description: Personal data sent over networks is protected with current TLS or SSH, and plain-text protocols are disabled.

Attributes.Section: A06 Security of processing: access and encryption
Attributes.Comment: Plain-language drafting, not legal text; not yet verified against the Law or its Executive Regulations.

Requirements.Name: A06.03 Key management
Requirements.Description: Encryption keys are rotated, access to them is restricted, and they are never publicly accessible.

Attributes.Section: A06 Security of processing: access and encryption
Attributes.Comment: Plain-language drafting, not legal text; not yet verified against the Law or its Executive Regulations.

Requirements.Name: A06.04 Least privilege
Requirements.Description: People and systems have only the access they need; administrator rights are limited, reviewed and removed when no longer needed.

Attributes.Section: A06 Security of processing: access and encryption
Attributes.Comment: Plain-language drafting, not legal text; not yet verified against the Law or its Executive Regulations.

Requirements.Name: A06.05 Strong authentication
Requirements.Description: Privileged and remote access requires multi-factor authentication, and password rules prevent weak passwords.

Attributes.Section: A06 Security of processing: access and encryption
Attributes.Comment: Plain-language drafting, not legal text; not yet verified against the Law or its Executive Regulations.

Requirements.Name: A06.06 No public exposure of data stores
Requirements.Description: Databases, storage buckets, snapshots and backups that hold personal data are not reachable from the internet.

Attributes.Section: A06 Security of processing: access and encryption
Attributes.Comment: Plain-language drafting, not legal text; not yet verified against the Law or its Executive Regulations.

Requirements.Name: A06.07 Network protection
Requirements.Description: Firewalls or security groups allow only the network traffic that is needed, and administrative ports are not open to the internet.

Attributes.Section: A06 Security of processing: access and encryption
Attributes.Comment: Plain-language drafting, not legal text; not yet verified against the Law or its Executive Regulations.

Requirements.Name: A06.08 Patching and vulnerability management
Requirements.Description: Systems that process personal data receive security updates promptly and are checked for known vulnerabilities.

Attributes.Section: A06 Security of processing: access and encryption
Attributes.Comment: Plain-language drafting, not legal text; not yet verified against the Law or its Executive Regulations.

Requirements.Name: A06.09 Host hardening
Requirements.Description: Servers are hardened: remote administrator login is restricted and sensitive system files are readable only by those who need them.

Attributes.Section: A06 Security of processing: access and encryption
Attributes.Comment: Plain-language drafting, not legal text; not yet verified against the Law or its Executive Regulations.

Requirements.Name: A07.01 Audit logging enabled
Requirements.Description: Administrative and security events are logged on all accounts and servers that process personal data.

Attributes.Section: A07 Logging, monitoring and breach detection
Attributes.Comment: Plain-language drafting, not legal text; not yet verified against the Law or its Executive Regulations.

Requirements.Name: A07.02 Log retention and protection
Requirements.Description: Logs are kept for a defined period and protected against tampering and deletion.

Attributes.Section: A07 Logging, monitoring and breach detection
Attributes.Comment: Plain-language drafting, not legal text; not yet verified against the Law or its Executive Regulations.

Requirements.Name: A07.03 Threat detection
Requirements.Description: Automated threat detection monitors accounts and systems for signs of compromise.

Attributes.Section: A07 Logging, monitoring and breach detection
Attributes.Comment: Plain-language drafting, not legal text; not yet verified against the Law or its Executive Regulations.

Requirements.Name: A07.04 Security alerting
Requirements.Description: Alerts are raised and reviewed for high-risk events such as root account use, unauthorised access attempts and changes to security settings.

Attributes.Section: A07 Logging, monitoring and breach detection
Attributes.Comment: Plain-language drafting, not legal text; not yet verified against the Law or its Executive Regulations.

Requirements.Name: A07.05 Access to personal data is traceable
Requirements.Description: Reads of and changes to stores of personal data are logged so that access can be traced to a person or system.

Attributes.Section: A07 Logging, monitoring and breach detection
Attributes.Comment: Plain-language drafting, not legal text; not yet verified against the Law or its Executive Regulations.

Requirements.Name: A08.01 Breach response plan
Requirements.Description: A written breach response plan names who decides, who investigates and who notifies.

Attributes.Comment: Plain-language drafting, not legal text; not yet verified against the Law or its Executive Regulations.

Requirements.Name: A08.02 Notifying the regulator
Requirements.Description: Personal data breaches are reported to the regulator within the deadline set by the regulations (configurable in this platform).

Attributes.Comment: Plain-language drafting, not legal text; not yet verified against the Law or its Executive Regulations.

Requirements.Name: A08.03 Informing affected people
Requirements.Description: People affected by a breach are informed when required, in plain language, with steps they can take.

Attributes.Comment: Plain-language drafting, not legal text; not yet verified against the Law or its Executive Regulations.

Requirements.Name: A08.04 Breach register
Requirements.Description: Every breach is recorded, including those not notified, with the facts, effects and actions taken.

Attributes.Comment: Plain-language drafting, not legal text; not yet verified against the Law or its Executive Regulations.

Requirements.Name: A08.05 Plan is tested
Requirements.Description: The breach response plan is tested through an exercise at set intervals, and lessons are recorded.

Attributes.Comment: Plain-language drafting, not legal text; not yet verified against the Law or its Executive Regulations.

Requirements.Name: A09.01 Written processor contracts
Requirements.Description: Every supplier that processes personal data on the organization's behalf has a written contract covering instructions, confidentiality, security and breach notification.

Attributes.Comment: Plain-language drafting, not legal text; not yet verified against the Law or its Executive Regulations.

Requirements.Name: A09.02 Supplier due diligence
Requirements.Description: Suppliers' safeguards are checked before they are engaged and reviewed periodically.

Attributes.Comment: Plain-language drafting, not legal text; not yet verified against the Law or its Executive Regulations.

Requirements.Name: A09.03 Recipients list
Requirements.Description: The organization keeps a current list of every third party that receives personal data, and why.

Attributes.Comment: Plain-language drafting, not legal text; not yet verified against the Law or its Executive Regulations.

Requirements.Name: A09.04 Sub-processors controlled
Requirements.Description: Suppliers pass personal data to their own subcontractors only with the organization's approval.

Attributes.Comment: Plain-language drafting, not legal text; not yet verified against the Law or its Executive Regulations.

Requirements.Name: A10.01 Transfer inventory
Requirements.Description: Every flow of personal data outside Egypt, including cloud hosting and remote support, is identified with its destination country and purpose.

Attributes.Comment: Plain-language drafting, not legal text; not yet verified against the Law or its Executive Regulations.

Requirements.Name: A10.02 Transfer permits
Requirements.Description: A permit is obtained from the regulator for each cross-border transfer that likely requires one, and its conditions are followed.

Attributes.Comment: Plain-language drafting, not legal text; not yet verified against the Law or its Executive Regulations.

Requirements.Name: A10.03 Transfer safeguards
Requirements.Description: Each transfer is covered by safeguards appropriate to the destination, such as contract terms and encryption.

Attributes.Comment: Plain-language drafting, not legal text; not yet verified against the Law or its Executive Regulations.

Requirements.Name: A11.01 Controller or processor licence
Requirements.Description: The organization holds a current licence from the regulator to act as a controller or processor, where one is likely required.

Attributes.Section: A11 Licences, permits and special processing
Attributes.Comment: Plain-language drafting, not legal text; not yet verified against the Law or its Executive Regulations.

Requirements.Name: A11.02 Electronic marketing
Requirements.Description: Electronic marketing is sent only with the recipient's agreement, offers an easy way to opt out, and is covered by a permit where one is likely required.

Attributes.Section: A11 Licences, permits and special processing
Attributes.Comment: Plain-language drafting, not legal text; not yet verified against the Law or its Executive Regulations.

Requirements.Name: A11.03 Surveillance
Requirements.Description: Surveillance such as CCTV is limited to what is necessary, signposted, and covered by a permit where one is likely required.

Attributes.Section: A11 Licences, permits and special processing
Attributes.Comment: Plain-language drafting, not legal text; not yet verified against the Law or its Executive Regulations.

Requirements.Name: A11.04 Renewals tracked
Requirements.Description: Expiry dates of licences and permits are tracked, and renewal starts well before they lapse.

Attributes.Section: A11 Licences, permits and special processing
Attributes.Comment: Plain-language drafting, not legal text; not yet verified against the Law or its Executive Regulations.
